name: CommuteAssistMetroConnection

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short metro commute scene. A person on the metro asks their assistant a quick question about platform, connection, or timing. Minimal dialogue only.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Subway ambient noise, metro car rattling, underground station, distant announcement

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short metro commute. The person is riding the metro. They ask Sigma one quick question — which platform, which line to transfer to, or whether their connection is on time. Sigma answers in one sentence.

variations.context: Quick metro connection check on the way into the city

setting.mood: Mildly zoned out, phone in hand
setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo commuter in a crowded metro
setting.background: Regular commute. Knows the lines but not which platform today.
setting.conversation_style: One short question asked quietly. One answer. Nod and move.

scenario_template.topic: Commuter asks Sigma about connection — platform, line, or timing
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. Said under their breath or into phone. E.g. 'Sigma, which platform for line 4?' or 'Sigma, does the 9:12 wait for this one?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives a one-line answer. Person adjusts — stands up, moves toward door.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: one sentence. User: a small physical reaction or nothing at all.

user1.name: Lena
user1.role: Daily tube commuter, efficient and observant. Uses Sigma for precise transit info. Speaks quietly in public and doesn't waste words.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Transit assistant. Answers in one short sentence: platform number, line name, or timing. Nothing more.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
User speaks quietly — in transit, surrounded by strangers.
Sigma answers with the one key fact needed.
No conversation beyond the question and answer.
A silent reaction or brief gesture is enough.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Sigma gives platform, line, or time — one sentence.
No padding. No 'of course'. No follow-up questions.
